definitions.shape: One sample per second in open play, outfield players only; defence line is mean defender X in own attacking coordinates.
definitions.support: Existing support/build-support/return-support target states; measured actual positions, not target positions.
definitions.pass: All actual release() actions counted by passes[], including restarts; direction is relative to own attack.
definitions.limitations: Small synthetic sample; divergent match trajectories do not establish causal win-rate or realism gains. Legacy tests/assets were absent in supplied checkout.
